identity_lookup.name: oidc_userinfo
identity_lookup.description: Return OIDC userinfo derived from access token and scopes; used to verify downstream principal identity and scope-controlled attribute release.

query_params.accessToken: Optional alternative to Authorization header; use the access token obtained from oauth_access_token

response_fields.sub: Subject identifier for principal binding checks

identity_lookup.name: get_account
identity_lookup.description: Retrieve the full Casdoor user object for the current account; includes originalToken visibility rules relevant to data exposure testing.

response_fields.data.name: Username as seen by Casdoor (principal binding)
response_fields.data.originalToken: Upstream OAuth provider token; should be visible only to self or admin (privacy/access control)

access_test.name: mcp_jsonrpc
access_test.description: Call MCP JSON-RPC endpoint to test scope enforcement vs session-cookie bypass behavior and tool authorization binding.

response_fields.result.tools: Tool list filtered by scopes when using Bearer token; full list for session auth

session_token_inspect.name: oauth_token_introspection
session_token_inspect.description: Validate token activity and inspect exp/iat/nbf/aud/sub/iss for replay and audience binding checks.

response_fields.active: Whether the token is currently valid (revoked/expired tokens should be inactive)
response_fields.scope: Granted scopes for authorization binding checks
response_fields.client_id: Client/application the token was issued to
response_fields.username: Username associated with the token (if user token)
